messages:
Ben: Quick sync — Horizon enterprise trial cutover timeline + network/mock API ownership. Who's taking staging sim and API contract? Need go/no-go by next Tue.
Priya: I can own staging sim infra. Need the test payload shapes and expected qps. Any sample traces?
Alice: I'll own API contract and test harness. Sending sample payloads to the thread. Also need to know if we can use Dedicated capacity for trial (SLA).
Ben: @Alice great. Customer expects ~100k tokens/day, ~50 rps peak. Success criteria: <150ms p50, <500ms p95 for gen calls; embedding latency <50ms. No PII in logs.
Marco: Dedicated capacity is fine but provisioning needs 2 days lead time. Can we lock exact slots? Prefer Tue–Thu 10:00–18:00 UTC for dry-run.
Tanya: CS will validate success criteria and run acceptance flows. We'll need a replay dataset. @Alice can you sanitize/produce one?
Alice: Sample payload (sanitized):
```json
{
  "session_id": "hzn-xyz-001",
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Summarize quarterly report."}],
  "metadata": {"region":"eu-west-1","redwood_customer_id":"horizon-123"}
}
```
Use endpoint `/v1/horizon/generate` with `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>` and allow CORS for staging.
Priya: Infra tickets I'll create:
- RW-4123: staging cluster + network ACLs
- RW-4124: mock upstream + replay infra
- RW-4125: quota & rate-limit config
I'll create RW-4123 today. ETA: Fri EOD for cluster, Mon for mocks.
Ben: Who owns certs + webhooks? Customer requires mutual TLS for callbacks.
Marco: I'll own certs. Need DNS entry and KMS access. Please open RW-4126 for DNS + KMS perms.
Alice: Code review ping: PR #8845 updates contract + auth flow. @Priya @Marco please eyeball the auth bits.
Priya: Reviewing PR now. Small change requested for header validation.
Marco: I'll add the DNS ticket and kick off cert ordering. Can we test with Let's Encrypt first then swap to company CA later?
Tanya: Onboarding call with customer Thu 16:00 UTC. Recommend dry-run Wed 11:00 UTC — setting calendar invite now.
Ben: Quick owners check — please ack with short ETA:
- staging infra owner
- api contract owner
- certs owner
- CS validation
- PR review
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: RW-4123 created by @Priya — https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RW-4123
Priya: staging infra owner — ACK. ETA Fri EOD for cluster provisioning.
Alice: api contract owner — ACK. Will send sanitized replay by Tue 09:00 UTC.
Marco: certs owner — ACK. RW-4126 created. Starting cert process; ETA Mon afternoon for DNS/KMS setup.
Tanya: CS validation — ACK. Dry-run Wed 11:00 UTC confirmed.
Priya: PR review — ACK. Merged after minor fix. :white_check_mark:
Ben: Thanks all :thumbsup: I'll update the tracking doc and notify the customer. If any blockers, flag here.
